2607.13344.title: EZSMT Version 3, Matured
2607.13344.paper_summary: Constraint Answer Set Programming (CASP) is a hybrid reasoning paradigm that combines Answer Set Programming (ASP) with Constraint Processing and Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT), enabling powerful declarative encodings of complex combinatorial search problems. This paper presents the design and implementation of EZSMTV3, an extensible SMT-based CASP framework that advances the translational approach to CASP solving. Building upon the foundation of the EZSMT+ system, EZSMTV3 introduces a more expressive input language, supports optimization via weak constraints, and offers foundations for streamlined integration of new constraint types. Rather than implementing custom search procedures, EZSMTV3 leverages state-of-the-art SMT solvers, such as CVC5, YICES, and Z3 to perform reasoning. The paper provides benchmarking results comparing EZSMTV3 with its CASP peers such as CLINGCON, CLINGO[DL], and CLINGO[LP], while showcasing its ability to handle mixed-domain constraints involving both integers and reals. The system provides a robust platform for future extensions and theoretical exploration within the CASP domain.
2607.13344.paper_summary_zh: 限制答案集程式設計（CASP）是一種混合推理範式，結合了答案集程式設計（ASP）、約束處理和模組理論可滿足性（SMT），使得對複雜組合搜尋問題的強大聲明性編碼成為可能。本文介紹了EZSMTV3的設計與實現，這是一個可擴展的基於SMT的CASP框架，推進了CASP求解的翻譯方法。在EZSMT+系統的基礎上，EZSMTV3引入了更具表達力的輸入語言，通過弱約束支持優化，並為新約束類型的簡化整合提供了基礎。EZSMTV3並未實現自定義搜尋程序，而是利用最先進的SMT求解器，如CVC5、YICES和Z3來進行推理。本文提供了EZSMTV3與其CASP同行，如CLINGCON、CLINGO[DL]和CLINGO[LP]的基準結果，同時展示了其處理涉及整數和實數的混合領域約束的能力。該系統為未來的擴展和CASP領域內的理論探索提供了一個穩健的平台。
2607.13344.author: Yuliya Lierler et.al.
